name: Explicit Molecular Taxonomy Edge Diagnostic
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The drug directly physically engages a molecular target The pinned descendant closure is biolink:binds, biolink:directly_physically_interacts_with.; The molecular target has an explicit graph-edge taxonomic assignment to the organism The pinned descendant closure is biolink:in_taxon.; The same taxonomically identified organism is asserted to cause the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes.
hypothesis: An explicit in_taxon graph edge would provide a directly queryable taxonomic link; its absence must remain distinguishable from the available node-property representation.

nodes.role: Organism asserted to cause the disease
nodes.explanation: Organism asserted to cause the disease.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: The drug directly physically engages a molecular target The pinned descendant closure is biolink:binds, biolink:directly_physically_interacts_with.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The molecular target has an explicit graph-edge taxonomic assignment to the organism The pinned descendant closure is biolink:in_taxon.

edges.subject: organism
edges.explanation: The same taxonomically identified organism is asserted to cause the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes.

mechanism.rationale: An explicit in_taxon graph edge would provide a directly queryable taxonomic link; its absence must remain distinguishable from the available node-property representation. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[taxonomy:{{relationship_types:taxonomy}}]->(organism:OrganismTaxon) WHERE taxonomy.predicate IN {{predicates:taxonomy}} MATCH (organism:OrganismTaxon)-[infection:{{relationship_types:infection}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE infection.predicate IN {{predicates:infection}} RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT organism) AS support_count

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
The raw node taxonomy fields do not provide annotation-level primary-source provenance.
Taxonomic membership does not establish target essentiality, exposure, inhibition in an organism, or clinical efficacy.
Organism-causes-disease assertions can be broad or text-mined and do not prove a pathogen-specific clinical mechanism.
This diagnostic requires a real in_taxon relationship and does not read the similarly named raw node property.
Support counts distinct organism nodes; physical engagement alone does not establish inhibition.
